'''Sprawl 18''' was a floating ranch located on the planet [[Tyed Kant]]. It housed [[Gryseium Incorporated]], a subsidiary of [[Corazon Industries]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Sabel Axis Corazon]] had the [[Mynock virus]] developed here. Her plans were thwarted by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents, who infected Sprawl 18 with the modified [[Mynock II virus]].<ref name="MC" />
